purpose: Recover useful social residue from conversations without converting every utterance into a binding task.

lineage.source: App Atlas / APP-022 Kagemusha / Promise Keeper
lineage.invariant: Protect attention by turning communication obligations into explicit queues, drafts, promises, follow-ups, and closure.
lineage.retained: Read-only extraction first; no autonomous sending.

lineage.invariant: Capture an idea once; preserve ancestry while it branches, merges, is tested, built, or killed.
Show projects, evidence, decisions, artifacts, branches, gaps, and next safe moves from shared records.

laws: CONVERSATION MAY CREATE RESIDUE WITHOUT CREATING AN OBLIGATION
OFFERS OF HELP ARE NOT AUTO-SCHEDULED WORK
PROMISE STRENGTH MUST NOT BE UPGRADED BY TONE OR FAMILIARITY
RETURN MAY CLOSE, RELEASE, DEFER, HAND OFF, SUPERSEDE OR COMPLETE
UNFOLLOWED IDEAS MAY STILL YIELD VALUE

strength.meaning: Something came up; no commitment implied.
User expressed intent, but timing/conditions may remain open.
Explicit commitment supported by source wording or later confirmation.
Explicit commitment plus a concrete time or external scheduling action.

admission.rule: Automated interpretation may propose a residue record, but only explicit source wording or human confirmation may promote strength to COMMIT or SCHEDULED.
admission.high_entropy_rule: BURST/interrupted speech may contain multiple residue candidates; recover separately and preserve uncertainty.
admission.value_first_rule: Before creating a task, ask what durable value can be preserved now: idea, artifact, decision context, donor mechanism, useful question, contact context, or next safe move.

return_semantics.purpose: Close the loop without moralizing unfinished work.

outcomes.meaning: Useful value was preserved even though the original follow-through did not occur.
No longer worth pursuing; closed deliberately.
Still relevant, but not active now.
A better/newer path replaced this residue.

human_port.role: Capture and show only conversation-relevant residue around the current person/thread.
human_port.avoid: Do not become a global task dashboard.

atlas.role: Preserve idea lineage, project relevance, evidence, branches and reusable value.

dayline.role: Project only items that have earned temporal attention.

forward_center_mass.role: Promote at most a few residue items into active execution when they affect NOW.

backstage.role: Preserve selected funny/strange making-history when it explains how value emerged.

examples.input: I can help my cousin think through an app idea.
examples.anti_pattern: Do not create 'BUILD COUSIN APP' as a task merely from this sentence.

examples.input: I said I'd look at those paintings and send thoughts.
